intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按中文工程线记忆：Hubble telescope 被 NASA 发射到太空，花费巨大；从一开始就有 trouble，因为 main mirror faulty，pictures disappointing；NASA 准备派 astronauts 乘 Endeavour 去 repair it；Hubble 在 atmosphere 外，所以能传回 stars 和 distant galaxies 的清晰图片。读的时候注意 was launched、at a cost of、faulty、put the telescope right、while、above the atmosphere 和 will have sent。

sentences.text: The Hubble telescope was launched into space by NASA on April 20, 1990 at a cost of over a billion dollars.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：哈勃望远镜由 NASA 在 1990 年 4 月 20 日发射到太空，花费超过十亿美元。注意 was launched 是被动语态，at a cost of 是正式报道里的花费表达。
focus_words: at a cost of over a billion dollars

sentences.text: Right from the start there was trouble with the Hubble.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：从一开始，Hubble 就有问题。Right from the start 要读出“立刻、刚开始就”的感觉，trouble with the Hubble 是标题里的核心问题。

sentences.text: The pictures it sent us were very disappointing because its main mirror was faulty!
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：它传回来的照片很令人失望，因为主镜有缺陷。Because 后面给原因，faulty 是冷静的工程词，不是灾难片式的夸张说法。

sentences.text: NASA is now going to put the telescope right, so it will soon be sending up four astronauts to repair it.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：NASA 准备把望远镜修好，所以很快会送四名宇航员上去维修。Put the telescope right 是“修好问题”，so 带出下一步行动。

sentences.text: The shuttle Endeavour will be taking the astronauts to the Hubble.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：奋进号航天飞机会把宇航员带到 Hubble 那里。Endeavour 是航天飞机的名字，will be taking 读出即将执行任务的感觉。

sentences.text: A robot arm from the Endeavour will grab the telescope and hold it while the astronauts make the necessary repairs.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：Endeavour 上的机械臂会抓住并托住望远镜，同时宇航员进行必要维修。Grab and hold 是机械臂动作，while 表示两件事同时发生。
focus_words: while the astronauts make the necessary repairs

sentences.text: Of course, the Hubble is above the earth's atmosphere, so it will soon be sending us the clearest pictures of the stars and distant galaxies that we have ever seen.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：Hubble 在地球大气层外，所以会传回我们见过最清晰的恒星和遥远星系图片。Above the earth's atmosphere 是原因，clearest pictures 是结果。

sentences.text: The Hubble will tell us a great deal about the age and size of the universe. By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands and thousands of wonderful pictures.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：Hubble 会告诉我们很多关于宇宙年龄和大小的信息；等你读到这篇时，它敏锐的眼睛已经送回成千上万张精彩照片。A great deal about 是很多信息，will have sent 是 future perfect。
focus_words: the age and size of the universe
By the time you read this
